# Milta Accounting Services Pvt. Ltd

> Outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, tax preparation and back-office
> support for small and mid-sized businesses in the United States and the United
> Kingdom, delivered from Coimbatore, India. Services are organised by region
> (`/us/...` for the United States, `/uk/...` for the United Kingdom), then by
> service, industry, and US state.

## About

- [About Milta](https://www.miltafs.com/about): Company background, leadership and how the delivery model works.
- [Services overview](https://www.miltafs.com/services): Index of every service line offered to US clients.
- [Areas we serve](https://www.miltafs.com/areas-we-serve): US states with dedicated service pages.
- [Contact](https://www.miltafs.com/contact): Enquiry form, phone and office address.
- [Careers](https://www.miltafs.com/career): Working at Milta and current openings.

## Services (United States)

- [Bookkeeping](https://www.miltafs.com/us/services/bookkeeping-company-in-the-usa/): Day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations and clean-up work.
- [Tax planning and preparation](https://www.miltafs.com/us/services/tax-planning-and-preparation-services-usa/): Federal and state return preparation and planning support.
- [Payroll management](https://www.miltafs.com/us/services/payroll-management-services-in-the-usa/): Payroll processing, filings and compliance.
- [CPA services](https://www.miltafs.com/us/services/best-cpa-services-for-small-businesses-in-the-usa/): CPA-supervised services for small businesses.
- [Financial controller services](https://www.miltafs.com/us/services/financial-controller-services-in-the-usa/): Outsourced controller and management reporting.
- [Accounting data entry](https://www.miltafs.com/us/services/outsourcing-accounting-data-entry-services-in-the-usa/): High-volume transaction and document data entry.
- [Virtual assistant services](https://www.miltafs.com/us/services/virtual-assistant-service-in-the-usa/): Administrative and back-office support staff.
- [Digital marketing](https://www.miltafs.com/us/services/best-digital-marketing-agency-in-usa/): Marketing services offered alongside the accounting practice.
